title: Untitled (Targets and Discs)
description: Large-scale collage presented in a black frame with white mat, featuring a prominent blank white rectangle at center flanked by dense lateral zones. Left side carries stacked compact discs and an American football; right side displays concentric target rings and geometric triangles in blue and orange; a bold red horizontal stripe anchors the lower register.
composition: framed white void flanked by dense lateral zones
